review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. California Sea Grant and OPC sources support warm/cold-period population shifts and pelagic habitat; numeric SST preference is not calibrated and bathymetry is a weak proxy.

profile.size: Min limit 24 inches FL / Bag limit 10 per harvester / day
profile.diet: Small fish, crustaceans, squids, and pelagic prey
profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for pacific bonito.
factors.value_notes: California Sea Grant reports Pacific bonito abundance fluctuates with warm/cold Pacific Decadal Oscillation periods, and the OPC species report places greatest abundance in warm waters between Magdalena Bay and Point Conception. This supports SST as a relevant regional factor, but no numeric preferred SST curve validates the configured 15-24 °C range or 17-22 °C ideal.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for pacific bonito.
factors.value_notes: Pacific bonito is pelagic and schooling, with younger fish near kelp/bays and larger fish offshore. Sources report water-column depths around 80-200 m or occurrence to 91-110 m, but those are fish occupancy depths, not seafloor bathymetry. The configured 0-40 m bottom-depth band is only a weak nearshore/shelf proxy, not a direct depth preference.

text.day: Full daylight when Pacific gamefish actively hunt.

timing.note: West Coast captain reports and biological upwelling patterns.

regulations.summary: CDFW: 24" min FL or 5 lb; 10 per day
